DO $do$
DECLARE
  got_lock boolean;
BEGIN
  got_lock := pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(429552);
  IF NOT got_lock THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'cache_inventario: otra sync en curso, skipping';
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Step 1: upsert filas OCS (incluye hardware_uuid SMBIOS).
  INSERT INTO msp_cache.cache_inventario (
    workgroup, hostname, mac, bios_serial, hardware_uuid,
    os, os_version, cpu, cpu_cores, cpu_speed_mhz, ram_mb, disk_gb, disk_type,
    ip, ocs_id, ocs_last_contact, ocs_username,
    source
  )
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (
    ocs.workgroup,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(REPLACE(ocs.mac, '-', ':')), ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ocs.bios_serial, ''), ''),
    ocs.name
  )
    ocs.workgroup,
    ocs.name,
    NULLIF(UPPER(REPLACE(ocs.mac, '-', ':')), ''),
    NULLIF(ocs.bios_serial, ''),
    NULLIF(ocs.hardware_uuid, ''),
    ocs.os, ocs.os_version, ocs.cpu, ocs.cpu_cores, ocs.cpu_speed_mhz,
    ocs.ram_mb, ocs.disk_gb, ocs.disk_type,
    -- Aceptar IP en notación CIDR (X.X.X.X/N) — OCS usa eso
    CASE
      WHEN ocs.ip ~ '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(/[0-9]+)?$' THEN ocs.ip::inet
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    ocs.ocs_id, ocs.last_contact, ocs.username,
    'ocs-only'
  FROM msp_cache.cache_ocs_computers ocs
  WHERE ocs.workgroup IS NOT NULL AND ocs.workgroup <> ''
  ORDER BY
    ocs.workgroup,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(REPLACE(ocs.mac, '-', ':')), ''), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ocs.bios_serial, ''), ''),
    ocs.name,
    ocs.last_contact DESC NULLS LAST
  ON CONFLICT (workgroup, COALESCE(mac, ''), COALESCE(bios_serial, ''), hostname) DO UPDATE SET
    os = EXCLUDED.os, os_version = EXCLUDED.os_version,
    cpu = EXCLUDED.cpu, cpu_cores = EXCLUDED.cpu_cores,
    cpu_speed_mhz = EXCLUDED.cpu_speed_mhz, ram_mb = EXCLUDED.ram_mb,
    disk_gb = EXCLUDED.disk_gb, disk_type = EXCLUDED.disk_type,
    ip = EXCLUDED.ip, ocs_id = EXCLUDED.ocs_id,
    ocs_last_contact = EXCLUDED.ocs_last_contact,
    ocs_username = EXCLUDED.ocs_username,
    hardware_uuid = EXCLUDED.hardware_uuid,
    source = CASE WHEN msp_cache.cache_inventario.eset_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'merged' ELSE 'ocs-only' END,
    synced_at = NOW();

  -- ESTRATEGIA DE MATCHING:
  --   PRIMARIO:   hardware_uuid (SMBIOS UUID, ESET vía hardwareProfiles[].bios.uuid)
  --   SECUNDARIO: MAC (con OUI virtuales filtradas)
  --   TERCIARIO:  hostname-short SCOPED por cliente (workgroup ↔ eset_email)
  --   DESCARTADO: bios_serial (~0 matches por OEM garbage en OCS)

  -- Step 2a: enrich por hardware_uuid (PRIMARIO).
  UPDATE msp_cache.cache_inventario inv SET
    eset_uuid = ed.uuid, eset_display_name = ed.display_name,
    eset_last_seen = ed.last_seen, eset_status = ed.status,
    eset_threats = ed.threats, eset_products = ed.products,
    eset_email = ed.eset_email,
    source = 'merged', source_match = 'uuid', synced_at = NOW()
  FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_devices ed
  WHERE inv.hardware_uuid IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(inv.hardware_uuid) >= 8
    AND ed.hardware_uuid IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ed.hardware_uuid) >= 8
    AND UPPER(TRIM(inv.hardware_uuid)) = UPPER(TRIM(ed.hardware_uuid))
    AND inv.eset_uuid IS NULL;

  -- Step 2b: enrich por MAC (secundario). Filtra MACs virtuales (VPN, hypervisor)
  -- que se duplican entre máquinas y romperían el matching, y dedupea con
  -- DISTINCT ON ambos lados para evitar el "ON CONFLICT cannot affect row twice".
  WITH unique_mac_ocs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (mac) inv_id, mac
    FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario
    WHERE mac IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(mac) >= 11 AND eset_uuid IS NULL
      AND mac NOT LIKE '00:09:0F:%' AND mac NOT LIKE '00:15:5D:%'
      AND mac NOT LIKE '00:50:56:%' AND mac NOT LIKE '00:0C:29:%'
      AND mac NOT LIKE '52:54:00:%' AND mac NOT LIKE '00:1C:42:%'
      AND mac NOT LIKE '08:00:27:%'
    ORDER BY mac, inv_id
  ),
  unique_mac_eset AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (UPPER(REPLACE(mac, '-', ':')))
      UPPER(REPLACE(mac, '-', ':')) AS mac_norm,
      uuid, display_name, last_seen, status, threats, products, eset_email
    FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_devices
    WHERE mac IS NOT NULL AND mac <> '' AND mac <> '—'
    ORDER BY UPPER(REPLACE(mac, '-', ':')), uuid
  )
  UPDATE msp_cache.cache_inventario inv SET
    eset_uuid = ed.uuid, eset_display_name = ed.display_name,
    eset_last_seen = ed.last_seen, eset_status = ed.status,
    eset_threats = ed.threats, eset_products = ed.products,
    eset_email = ed.eset_email,
    source = 'merged', source_match = 'mac', synced_at = NOW()
  FROM unique_mac_ocs umo
  JOIN unique_mac_eset ed ON ed.mac_norm = umo.mac
  WHERE inv.inv_id = umo.inv_id;

  -- Step 2c: hostname-short SCOPED por cliente.
  -- Fallback cuando UUID y MAC fallaron. Limita el match a hostnames-short
  -- dentro del mismo cliente (workgroup OCS ↔ eset_email mapping). Reduce
  -- el riesgo de hostname collision: dos PCs en clientes distintos pueden
  -- llamarse PC01 sin que se mezclen, ya que el scope los aísla.
  WITH cliente_scope AS (
    -- workflow n8n inyecta este mapping desde crm_cache.cliente vía dblink.
    -- Acá usamos heurístico: lower(eset_email) empieza con lower(workgroup)+'%@'.
    SELECT DISTINCT
      inv.workgroup AS ocs_workgroup,
      ed.eset_email
    FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario inv
    CROSS JOIN msp_cache.cache_eset_devices ed
    WHERE inv.workgroup <> 'unknown-eset'
      AND ed.eset_email IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(ed.eset_email) LIKE LOWER(inv.workgroup) || '%@%'
  ),
  candidatos AS (
    SELECT inv.inv_id, ed.uuid, ed.display_name, ed.last_seen, ed.status,
           ed.threats, ed.products, ed.eset_email
    FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario inv
    JOIN cliente_scope cs ON cs.ocs_workgroup = inv.workgroup
    JOIN msp_cache.cache_eset_devices ed ON ed.eset_email = cs.eset_email
    WHERE inv.eset_uuid IS NULL
      AND LOWER(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(inv.hostname), '.', 1)) =
          LOWER(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(ed.display_name), '.', 1))
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario inv2 WHERE inv2.eset_uuid = ed.uuid
      )
  ),
  unique_candidatos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (uuid) inv_id, uuid, display_name, last_seen, status,
                              threats, products, eset_email
    FROM candidatos ORDER BY uuid, inv_id
  )
  UPDATE msp_cache.cache_inventario inv SET
    eset_uuid = c.uuid, eset_display_name = c.display_name,
    eset_last_seen = c.last_seen, eset_status = c.status,
    eset_threats = c.threats, eset_products = c.products,
    eset_email = c.eset_email,
    source = 'merged', source_match = 'hostname', synced_at = NOW()
  FROM unique_candidatos c
  WHERE inv.inv_id = c.inv_id;

  -- Step 3: ESET-only (sin match en OCS).
  INSERT INTO msp_cache.cache_inventario (
    workgroup, hostname, mac, eset_uuid, eset_display_name,
    eset_last_seen, eset_status, eset_threats, eset_products, eset_email,
    source
  )
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(REPLACE(ed.mac, '-', ':')), ''), ''),
    COALESCE(ed.display_name, '(sin nombre)')
  )
    'unknown-eset',
    COALESCE(ed.display_name, '(sin nombre)'),
    NULLIF(UPPER(REPLACE(ed.mac, '-', ':')), ''),
    ed.uuid, ed.display_name, ed.last_seen, ed.status, ed.threats, ed.products,
    ed.eset_email, 'eset-only'
  FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_devices ed
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario inv WHERE inv.eset_uuid = ed.uuid
  )
  ORDER BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(REPLACE(ed.mac, '-', ':')), ''), ''),
    COALESCE(ed.display_name, '(sin nombre)'),
    ed.last_seen DESC NULLS LAST
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  -- Step 4: detecciones (replace all) — GUARD anti-truncate (fix B2 2026-06-08):
  -- no truncar si la fuente cache_eset_detections esta stale (>48h o vacia),
  -- para no borrar el ultimo dato bueno. Con sincro_eset_detections (05:00) fresca, procede normal.
  IF (SELECT now() - max(synced_at) FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_detections) < interval '48 hours' THEN
    TRUNCATE msp_cache.cache_inventario_detecciones;
    INSERT INTO msp_cache.cache_inventario_detecciones (inv_id, eset_uuid, category, severity, occur_time)
    SELECT inv.inv_id, det.uuid, det.category, det.severity, det.occur_time
    FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_detections det
    JOIN msp_cache.cache_inventario inv ON inv.eset_uuid = det.device_uuid;
  ELSE
    RAISE WARNING 'cache_eset_detections stale (max synced_at %); skip truncate, keep last good',
      (SELECT max(synced_at) FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_detections);
  END IF;
END
$do$;
